# Chrome Extension Permission Checker

> Free, browser-local checker: scans your extension's JavaScript/TypeScript source for chrome.* API usage and compares it against manifest.json's declared permissions, so an unused or missing permission doesn't cost you a Chrome Web Store rejection ('Purple Potassium'). Nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
